description: This Java class is a command handler within the Fineract project that processes requests to undo transactions on a savings account. It implements the command handling interface, injects a service for savings account operations, and defines the processCommand method to execute the undo action.

classes.name: UndoTransactionSavingsAccountCommandHandler
classes.description: A service class that handles the undo transaction command for savings accounts, invoking the write platform service to perform the undo operation.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the undo transaction command by extracting the transaction ID and invoking the undoTransaction method on the savings account service.
